feeds.title: 50 Is Not Old
feeds.description: Hi, I am Tania. This is my personal blog where I show everybody how they can look stylish, even when on a tight budget. Young at heart is my motto. If you only act your age, you will miss out on a ton of fun. Live life to the fullest, and look good along the way.

feeds.title: - Jodie's Touch of Style
feeds.description: My goal for the blog is Women Over 50 Inspiring Style for Many Sizes & Budgets. I'd love to inspire style for women of many ages, sizes and budgets. Just because your driver's license says a certain number does not mean that you can't continue looking fabulous!

feeds.title: Privilege Blog
feeds.description: Privilege can teach you what color shoes to wear with navy blue, nothing beats the privilege of being alive. So let's talk style, in the context of culture. Let's focus on the over-50.

feeds.title: Over 50 Feeling 40
feeds.description: Fashion and Lifestyle Blog for women over 50 to help achieve strength, confidence, joy, inspiration, and, of course, head-turning personal style! Authored by Pamela Lutrell.

feeds.title: The Middle Page
feeds.description: Cathy is a Dallas fashion and lifestyle blogger focusing on women over 40. Her blog, The Middle Page focuses on Fashion among older people and brings out an eclectic mix of Fashion & Lifestyle articles reflecting the highs and standouts of classic looks. Read more on Fashion and Beauty in these articles.

feeds.title: A Well Styled Life
feeds.description: Welcome to A Well Styled Life, your online destination for fashion, beauty, and wellness. Here you'll find style tips and lifestyle inspiration to help you dress with confidence so you can live your best life over 50. I started this blog to help women navigate the current fashion and understand how to make it work for them. What worked in our 30's just doesn't cut it over 50. I provide actionable tips and style advice so you can embrace midlife knowing you look your best.

feeds.title: En Mode Basque
feeds.description: Hello, i am Sandrine from Biarritz in the south west of France. I created my blog 6 years ago for sharing My passion for fashion, makeup, skin care and elegance. I like helping mature women to create their perfect dressing, to be more stylish and élégant, to upgrade their outfits and their look easily.

feeds.title: Southern Hospitality Blog » Fashion Beauty & Fitness
feeds.description: Thanks for stopping by! I'm Rhoda, from Atlanta, GA and I love decorating and DIY projects. Decorating a home doesn't have to cost a fortune and I've spent years thrifting at antique markets and yard sales, finding those treasures that make a home unique. I'm here to inspire and encourage other women to find their own inner creativity. This section of the blog shares information and beauty tips for women over 50.

feeds.title: Une Femme D'un Certain Âge » Style
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Susan Blakey and I'm 64 and marrited. I am a former administrative executive who loves and writes about style, Paris, coffee, history, travel and more. This section of the blog covers style ideas and fashion for women over 50. How to evolve your personal style. How to build a cohesive wardrobe for any lifestyle.

feeds.title: Sharing Journey
feeds.description: Sharing a Journey is a Top Tampa Life and Style Blog in which Nina shares her beauty and fashion tips Welcome to Sharing A Journey! As women of a certain age, we know that while our bodies may have different ideas, we are still having fun, enjoying life, and full of dreams. The best part is that now we actually have the tools and wisdom to make them come true. My nest is empty, and I've been exploring and reconnecting to interests, passions and friends.

feeds.title: Stylin' Granny Mama Blog » Fashion
feeds.description: I am a 52-year-old wife, mother, grandmother living in Toledo, Ohio. Stylin' Granny Mama is my personal style blog where I share my fashion ideas and style tips for women over 50.

feeds.title: Hello I'm 50ish
feeds.description: Over 50 Fashion and Lifestyle Blog created by Robin LaMonte for women over 50. Robin shares her fashion, lifestyle and travel adventures with her followers as she embraces midlife at full throttle.

feeds.title: Fashion with Compassion
feeds.description: I also love fashion and style. I celebrated my 63nd birthday and I feel it's important for women to keep up with fitness and fashion no matter what age we are. I believe staying young and fashionable over 50 and beyond.

feeds.title: LivingBetter50 » Beauty & Fashion
feeds.description: LivingBetter50.com is the No.1 resource and magazine for women over 50 in the world with 500,000+ readers. LivingBetter50.com covers everything for a woman from 'Beauty-to-Business' with our primary goal: To encourage women to live better physically, emotionally, financially, and spiritually! This section of the blog covers Beauty & Fashion tips for women over 50 that can help you achieve a stylish, sophisticated and modern wardrobe.

feeds.title: Cindy Hattersley Design » Fashion Over 50
feeds.description: Hey, I'm Cindy Hattersley. Specializing in residential interior design I approach each job as a partnership between myself and my client. My job is to interpret my client's personal style while introducing them to potential ideas and inspiration so that their home will reflect their interests and passions rather than my own personal aesthetic. My own personal style is a collected layered look that looks as if it has been developed over time.

feeds.title: Style At A Certain Age » Fashion
feeds.description: Hey, I'm Beth Djalali, a girl that grew up in Omaha, Nebraska - a city and state that's smack dab in the middle of the country. Not exactly the fashion capital of the world, but not exactly hicksville either think no further than Warren Buffett who has claimed Omaha as his home for over 80 years. Besides sharing fashion inspiration, Style at a Certain Age is dedicated to aging with grace, strength, and beauty. Aging is a privilege, but as Bette Davis famously claimed, 'it's not for sissies.'

feeds.title: Over The Hilda
feeds.description: Over The Hilda is my personal blog where I post my beauty finds, fashion for the older woman, tips for health and well-being.

feeds.title: Shopping for the Real You Blog
feeds.description: Shopping for the Real You teaches you how to become your own stylist. Based on principles of art and human design, the illustrations, charts and questionnaires make the process fun, enlightening and foolproof.

feeds.title: SheShe Show
feeds.description: SheShe Show shares years of fashion and life experiences. As a former model, designer, and boutique owner I have found that STYLE has no finish line. This blog features Fashion over 40 alongside lifestyle and more!

feeds.title: Chic50Style Blog
feeds.description: Chic50style Womens fashion and lifestyle website for midlife trendy ageless chic. Discover how dressing over 50 style is discovering yourself again.The over 50 influencer & over 50 blogger Tina Dutton encourages mature women to stand out from the high street.

feeds.title: Prime Women » Beauty & Fashion
feeds.description: Our beauty and fashion section features makeup experts, cosmetic surgeons, dermatologists, fashion experts and high profile hair stylists that keep us looking our best. PRiME is for the ageless generation of women who don't dress, think, or act like women in previous generations. We are unique. Just as our teen and adult lives did not mirror our mothers, neither do our lives at 50, 60, or 70.

feeds.title: SusanAfter60.com » Fashion
feeds.description: I blogged for five years as Fifty, not Frumpy. Now that I am sixty, I am honoring this new decade with a great new website Susan After 60 .com Check out my fashion ideas and tips for after 60s, comfortable yet stylish clothing and more!

feeds.title: Chic Over 50
feeds.description: Shauna Robertson writes about fashion, make-up, skincare, fitness, and hairstyles. ChicOver50 is about inspiring women over 50 everywhere to be confident and beautiful.

feeds.title: Claire Justine » Over 50 Fashion
feeds.description: Inspiring Women To Feel Good. Claire Justine is UK Lifestyle blogger inspiring Women To Feel Good and breaking fashion boundaries.

feeds.title: Fashion Over Fifty
feeds.description: My Mission is to help every woman feel her inner and outer beauty no matter what her age. It's never too late for fulfill your dreams!!!

feeds.title: Chic at any age
feeds.description: My name is Josephine Lalwan. I started my fashion and beauty blog Chicatanyage ten years ago at the age of sixty. Chicatanyage is a fashion resource for women over 50 who want to learn more about style, fashion and what will suit them as mature women. Let us continue to enjoy fashion be stylish and chic at any age.

feeds.title: Fashion Trends and Friends
feeds.description: FTF was created by 3 life-long friends who love to follow fashion. ur mission is to create an online community where friends come together to find clothing options, outfits that are on trend, flattering, age appropriate and minimize problem areas.

feeds.title: Splendid Age Blog
feeds.description: Splendid Age is a Fashion and Lifestyle Blog for women over 50. It is a destination for women who appreciate the positive aspects of aging and are comfortable with the kind of woman they see themselves being.

feeds.title: Not Dead Yet Style
feeds.description: I am a sixty-something woman, wife, professional, auntie and crazy cat lady. Though pressured by society to recede gracefully, I prefer to burst out with a love of fashion and style. We are not dead yet, so let's enjoy every sandwich and gild the lilies. Check out my article for beauty and fashion tips, outfit ideas and more!

feeds.title: 1010 Park Place
feeds.description: I started 1010ParkPlace for the best-educated, most powerful women in history: women over 50. Here you can find like-minded women and relevant conversations about finances, fashion, music and food; interviews with inspiring women and straight-talk about health, divorce, death of a spouse, sex and bold conversations to reawaken your passions and make life count.

feeds.title: Nancy's Fashion Style
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Nancy. I am a 50 Dutch personal style blogger. On my blog I like to write about fashion, and all the things that we women like. Every Friday I host the Fancy Friday linkup and every first Tuesday of the month I present you the Styled By series.

feeds.title: Fabulous50s Blog » Fashion
feeds.description: Schellea Fowler is an energetic 50-something-year-old who is passionate about health, beauty, wellness and happiness. Beginning her career far removed from the world of social media, Schellea's entrepreneurial background is in the operation and development of small businesses with a particular penchant for conceptual and creative design. Focussing in on health and nutrition, exercise and wellbeing, her fashion tips empower the women to embrace all the great things that reaching their 50's has to offer.

feeds.title: In The Groove
feeds.description: In The Groove is the go-to place for women of a certain age for what you need to know, and maybe didn't even know you needed to know(until we came along) to stay in the groove. We are small group of women, led by One Kings Lane founder, Susan Feldman on a quest to stay engaged, connected. In The Groove curates product, makes informed recommendations, and offers up to the minute editorial content. We are spending our days (and nights), in conversation, research and product testing and then reporting back to you.

feeds.title: 55+ Life » Fashion
feeds.description: 55+ Life is your partner in navigating aging to live your best life. Whether it's lifestyle stories, health and wellness, retirement planning, exploring new places to travel to, considering new living options, or trying out a new recipe, 55+ Life is here to help you on your journey. Explore our fashion and wardrobe tips, styling ideas and inspirations and more!

feeds.title: Better After 50 » Fashion
feeds.description: Better After 50 is what women over 50 are reading. Unlike other blogs, posts and online magazines, we're about real women sharing real stories. Our site is designed to be personal and conversational all the things you'd confess to a friend over coffee. This category is for the best and worst of fashion, what to wear after 50, what not to wear after 50. We've got the scoop on fashion over 50, some tongue-in-cheek humor, and more for fashion-conscious women at midlife.

feeds.title: The Midlife Fashionista
feeds.description: Modern style inspiration for midlife women who are determined to do away with frumpy.

feeds.title: Mutton Years Style and I
feeds.description: A style for the Mutton Years attempts to find me, sometimes failing miserably, mostly failing.

feeds.title: 50isthenew50 Blog
feeds.description: I'm Karen, an over 50 gal that has figured out that age is just a number! I am so passionate about encouraging women of all ages to see their true beauty, know their worth, and feel confident again! I share ageless fashion ideas, makeup tutorials, lifestyle hacks, and healthy living tips for women that have figured out our age is just a number.

feeds.title: Awesome Over 50 » Fashion and Appearance
feeds.description: Over 3 years ago I dedicated my social platforms to helping those over 50 embrace this chapter of their lives.Although I'm a former model my messages go well beyond just makeup and fashion. It's my goal to share my journey with you with health tips, food, health, fun, travel, selfcare, and even a little makeup and fashion thrown into the mix. Keep up to date as I share fashion and beauty tips for changes in skin and body as aging progress.
